title: Live driver monitoring card with video canvas and controls
description: Implement web/src/components/CameraPanel.jsx displaying the prominent live video feed, Start/Stop Camera action buttons, active monitoring indicator dot, elapsed monitoring time timer, and clear camera error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays video stream canvas/image prominently as the central visual element (PRD 6.4)
Provides responsive Start Camera and Stop Camera toggle buttons
Displays clear state badge: Ready, Camera Active, Monitoring Unavailable, or Camera Error
Displays elapsed monitoring timer (HH:MM:SS) while active
Shows friendly placeholder when camera is stopped instead of an empty broken box

steps.details: Create web/src/components/CameraPanel.jsx with video display container, control bar, and telemetry badges.
When monitoring starts, start a 1s interval updating elapsed monitoring time, resetting upon stop.
Style card with rounded corners, aspect-ratio 16:9 or 4:3 video viewport, clear overlay badges, and distinct button hover/active states.
Run Playwright test verifying video panel renders with controls; click Start Camera and capture screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-23-1.png.

technicalNotes: Ensure controls have visible keyboard focus states.
Do not imply video recording is enabled if only live processing is running.
